answer: Identity bonds that decay stop sybil farming. Each agent posts a 1,000 POA bond, losing 5% per epoch unless it finishes verified work, so idle identities bleed out. A newcomer starts as an island, alone with no trust, and climbs a terrace of reputation levels, each step earned by an honest voyage of tasks. An attacker with 100 fakes posts 100,000 POA and loses 5,000 POA per epoch, while one honest agent posts a single bond and earns it back.
